node.title: H3 product-product-quotient factorial moment is at most 69n^2
node.statement: BACKGROUND SUFFICIENT ROUTE. For every official row, with P and R as in f3_h3_mobius_excess_half, M_21=sum_{t!=1}P(t)(P(t)-1)R(t) <=69n^2. Since (m-35)_+ <=m(m-1)/138 for every integer m, this implies X_35<=n^2/2 and closes the critical weighted leaf. The count is the exact codimension-two six-variable incidence ledger consisting of two distinct ordered product representations and one quotient representation of the same t. FALSIFIER: one official row with M_21>69n^2. Boundary calibration: M_21=132310328=1.971577525n^2 at (n,p)=(8192,67657729).
